modeling_notes: Range conflict: ONI 2015 A-tier gives a ~20-40 nm (37-74 km) spread (likely baseline vs improved round); Quwa B-tier gives 40 km baseline (matching export LY-80/LY-80N) and ~70+ km for HQ-16B/C-derived rounds; export HQ-16FE cites 160 km (B, export, not PLAN-confirmed). This record models the ONI A-tier spread's upper-middle figure as the primary range basis per authoring-standard preference ordering.

'HHQ-16 (B/C as sourced)' per task instruction: this single record represents the family (baseline HHQ-16 through reported HHQ-16B/C variants), since no source gives distinct per-variant flight-performance numbers; the range conflict/improvement is noted above rather than split into 3 near-duplicate records.

Engine note: for a vls_sam mount, the C++ weapon-release service overrides the fired missile's speed/turn_rate/fuse_distance/damage/max_flight_time_s from the ship record's naval_weapon_system.mounts[] fields, not from this standalone Missile record, per the repo's sm6.json convention. This record is documentation/reference only for VLS-launched HHQ-16; the ship record's mount fields drive actual in-engine outcomes.
